summary: Black Ops II has been statically recompiled to run natively on ARM64 macOS, providing a playable binary for Apple Silicon users. It is delivered as a CLI tool built from C++ sources and runs locally without external services. The project is aimed at enthusiasts who want to experience this specific title on modern Macs. While it stands out with 140 GitHub stars and a faster launch than comparable Doom ports, its documentation is sparse and test coverage is limited, indicating a prototype-level maturity.

github.description: Call of Duty: Black Ops II statically recompiled from 32-bit x86 Windows to native ARM64 macOS: Remill → LLVM IR, a hand-written Win32 runtime, Direct3D 11 drawn by Metal. No Wine, no game files.
